INSERT INTO likes (uri, cid, did, subject_uri, subject_cid, created_at)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
        ON CONFLICT (uri) DO UPDATE SET
            cid = EXCLUDED.cid,
            subject_uri = EXCLUDED.subject_uri,
            subject_cid = EXCLUDED.subject_cid,
            created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at
